newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar emir meets father he ousted.
newsitem.headline: Qatar emir meets father he ousted.

text.p: Qatar's Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani has met his father for the first time since he ousted him in a bloodless coup last year, the official Qatar News Agency said on Wednesday.
The emir and his father, Sheikh Khalifa bin Hamad al-Thani, met in Rome on Tuesday, the agency said but gave no details.
Officials said on Tuesday the meeting was intended to pave the way for Sheikh Khalifa's return home.

They said the former emir, who has been in self-imposed exile since his June 1995 ouster, would not return home immediately and that discussions continued on whether 200 of his followers would be allowed back. Qatar has accused them of taking part in a foiled coup plot in February.
The former emir has denied any involvement in the plot.

Qatari officials had said the former emir was expected to return following an agreement over billions of dollars missing from state coffers since his removal. Unofficial estimates put the sum he controlled between $3 billion and $7 billion.
